decisions.decision: Accept the honest zero for the seller dimension.
decisions.scope: Listings remains a health/alert watchtower (alerts, diffs, history, escalations) and does not get a forced copy-generation target. The copy artefact belongs to ListingForge (compose_listing); borrowing its score would be a false attribution.
decisions.effect: No code change. G2 stays 0.0 by design; the digest and scorecard label it an honest zero.

decisions.decision: Sponsored Products is the target ad type for the ad-copy caps.
decisions.scope: 60-character headline and 150-character body remain the product's own rules for this pass. Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display are out of scope until separately requested.
decisions.effect: tools/seller_tester/ad_copy.py records AD_TYPE = Sponsored Products (owner-confirmed); the briefs carry the confirmation; the score is unchanged (98.1 over 6, 5 passed).

decisions.scope: Open-licensed references only (CC0/BY/BY-SA), 800 px minimum short side, category term required; owner-supplied product photographs remain preferred where present. Missing owner photographs (Neck Nirvana, deeper Mogra coverage) limit depth but do not block the pipeline.
decisions.effect: tools/reference_coverage.py defaults already match; the Openverse connector follows the same gates.
